metadata.geometry_generalization: Official PRG polygons returned in EPSG:4326 with maxAllowableOffset=0.0001 degrees for interactive selection; never use a bounding rectangle as the AOI boundary.
limitations: Versioned local PRG catalogue for administrative selection; refresh only through this explicit maintenance command.
The preview receives a compact hierarchy index and requests selected official PRG boundary geometries on demand.
A selected geometry remains subject to provider AOI area safeguards before any OSM acquisition.
